about: The companies of the Island Exchange. Island companies (kind island) are invented: their names, tickers and stories are made up, they are not real businesses, and no real person or company is meant. Each one follows ONE real instrument at its real Binance price, one to one, with no amplification. Stock companies (kind stock) are real listed companies, shown with their real names and real share prices in a play-money simulation. There is no link to or endorsement by any of them, and no logos.
nameCheck: Not done yet for the island names. Before they ship, check each one against published games and real companies (docs/STORY.md, rule 5 of the story rules). Stock companies keep their real names on purpose.

companies.tagline: The old harbor bank. When it moves, the whole market feels it.
